scope: settlement integrity; goals, BTTS, provider-yellow-card research; corners protected
data: all locally available provider-native raw match/stats cache; no paid calls or downloads
chronology: coverage-only timestamp-group 60/20/20 split; 28h purge; expanding second fold when supported
optional_xg_arm: RICH_POISSON_XG on a separately support-matched goals cohort only
calibration: two regularized multiplicative side corrections fitted before test; preserve joint coherence
optional_features: overview.expected_goals xG in separate support-matched arm only; no npxG; no unverified event/lineup/referee/weather proxies
strength: lagged competition-local Elo feature, fixed K20 scale400 home50; outcomes enter Elo only after the same 28h eligibility rule; deterministic candidate not ground truth
venue: explicit feature: known non-neutral home=+1 away=-1, known neutral=0, unknown=missing; Elo home bonus 50 only when non-neutral is explicitly known
support: mandatory core own-production and opponent-concession history; exact provider paths; optional missingness explicit; no all-missing column accepted; duels_won_percentage is not treated as a count
confirmation: all available outcomes previously accessible; DEVELOPMENT_ONLY; no automatic promotion
promotion: requires untouched chronological predictive gain, calibration noninferiority and market-adjusted gate; unavailable odds -> MARKET_UNTESTED
search_budget: fixed alpha and bundles; no tuning after results; NB dispersion fitted train only; DC rho fitted train only
uncertainty: paired ISO-week block bootstrap, fixture rows grouped, 2000 resamples, seed=3201; nominal development intervals only
settlement: regulation score only; >=4h after kickoff; two coherent cached finished snapshots >=5m apart; ambiguity fails closed; revisions remain append-only
